ipaddr.description: IP address or hostname of the iLO2 management interface.

login.description: Username to authenticate to the iLO2 interface.

passwd.description: Password for the iLO2 account. Leave empty and use passwd_file for better security.

passwd_file.description: Path to a file containing the iLO2 password (e.g., /etc/fence_agents/ilo2_pass). Recommended over plaintext passwd.

interface.description: IPMI interface type. Use 'lan' for basic IPMI over LAN; 'lanplus' for IPMI 2.0 features (encryption, auth extensions).

port.description: UDP port for IPMI over LAN (standard is 623). Rarely changed.

privilege.description: IPMI privilege level required to perform fencing operations. 'user', 'operator', or 'admin'.

delay.description: Seconds to wait after powering on before attempting to check status.

ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for communication (if supported by iLO firmware). iLO2 supports only basic TLS 1.0 with limited cipher suites.

ssl_insecure.description: Skip certificate verification when SSL/TLS is enabled. Useful only in lab or internal environments with self-signed certs.

power_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a power command (e.g., 'on', 'off', 'status') to complete.

test.description: Enable test (dry-run) mode — parse config and validate parameters but do not send commands to the device.
